title: Inherently sequential nature of recurrent models limits parallelization
description: Recurrent models factor computation sequentially along symbol positions, precluding parallelization within training examples, a limitation that the Transformer addresses but is acknowledged as a fundamental constraint of prior approaches.
canonical_description: recurrent models sequential computation prevents parallel training within examples

evidence.quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths, as memory constraints limit batching across examples.
